headline: Six years ago today, Travis Scott @travisscott and McDonald’s released the Travis Scott Me
body: Six years ago today, Travis Scott @travisscott and McDonald’s released the Travis Scott Meal and employees everywhere were officially introduced to the words “Cactus Jack sent me” 😭🍟 Via: dylan.vino / The $6 meal included a Quarter Pounder with cheese, bacon and lettuce, medium fries with BBQ sauce and a Sprite. It marked the first time McDonald’s had featured a celebrity’s name on its menu since Michael Jordan’s McJordan meal in 1992. The collaboration became so popular that some locations temporarily ran low on the ingredients needed to make the meal, while fans flooded drive-thrus recreating the viral ordering trend. Travis and McDonald’s also released an entire Cactus Jack merch collection that included clothing, rugs and even a McNugget-shaped body pillow. The limited-time launch helped begin the modern era of celebrity meals at McDonald’s, but the employees who lived through it may still deserve compensation 😭
